lines.text: The concept is looked up as a Restaurant (Planning Code § 102).
Zoning district NCD-HAIGHT: a Restaurant on the first story is principally permitted (Planning Code § 719, in force from 2024-01-14 (Ord. 249-23, File No. 230701)).

Haight Street Alcohol Restricted Use Subdistrict: A new on-sale liquor establishment (ABC Types 40, 41, 42, 47, 48, 57: bars and restaurants serving alcohol) needs Conditional Use. The description does not say what alcohol will be served (beer and wine, or spirits too), so the licence type is not known and this is not decided (Planning Code § 781.9(c)(2), in force from 2024-01-14 (Ord. 249-23, File No. 230701)).

Hours: the description gives no closing time. Hours that are not principally permitted begin at 2 a.m. or later here (P 06:00-02:00; C 02:00-06:00; Planning Code § 719, in force since before 2022-01-01); the rules did not check a closing time after 2 a.m.
No active ABC licence of a type the rules read (Types 41, 42, 47, 48, 61, 75) is on file at 1463 Haight St, so the records do not show what the space is used as now.
Limited Restaurant to Restaurant is a change of use, with the last use of the space as described.
